info.name: Shinnosuke progress bar
info.description:
?️ Shinnosuke YouTube Progress Bar  
Make watching YouTube a little more fun with Shinnosuke! ❤️?  
This style replaces YouTube’s normal progress-bar scrubber with an animated Shinnosuke GIF. Shinnosuke moves along the progress bar as your video plays, creating a cute Crayon Shin-chan themed YouTube player.  
✨ Features:
• Animated Shinnosuke on the YouTube progress bar
• Moves along with the video progress
• Custom pink progress-bar colour
• Works directly on YouTube videos
• Cute and simple Shin-chan theme  
Enjoy watching YouTube with Shin-chan! ?✨
